about: Step Deck house look (fixed: one house look per style, new components every reel). From a reference reel by @ant.lon, replicated frame by frame, and a founding talking-head reel.
world: the speaker's talking head (two framings, as shot) cut every 1-2 s against flat full-screen cards: navy word cards, white word pages, a cream icon card, B&W paper prints, drawn diagrams, step cards with a giant italic numeral; the words are the graphic everywhere
layout: 1080x1920 at 30 fps (the reference is 25 fps; every frame count in SPEC is rescaled). On the face: one caption state at a time, centred on x 540, the baseline on the crown of the speaker's head + an offset by the line's biggest tier (T -38, M -10, B / S +14, G +26 px; build/crowns.json, measured from the matte), on a layer BETWEEN the plate and its matte so the head hides the lower part; two-line states stack upward. On cards: the words centred on y 960, two-line stacks grow down from there; B-roll captions in the empty space (y 1500 over a bench, ~650 over a wall). Step numeral centre (523, 946), 960 px tall. Diagram words at y 560, items at y 990-1150. Counter numeral at y 760, its words at 1190 / 1360. Nothing under the Instagram top bar (< 220) or the bottom UI (> 1500) except the pushed-back first frames.

type.captions: Inter Tight 600, tracking -0.04 em, sentence case, one state per spoken word (a new word, a phrase append in place, or a sub-line under it); on the face #FDFEFC with a soft shadow (0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)), never an outline or a pill; on navy #FAE9D4, on white pages #0F1827; size by importance in tiers (face: T 64, M 112, B 152, S 170, ST 76 px; cards: T 68, M 150, B 170, S 178, ST 80, L 120; B-roll: T 68, M 130, B 200, S 190), a line shrinks to fit 930 px but never under 56 px (the rule: >= 48 px)
type.display: serif voice: Playfair Display Italic 400 for the payoff or abstract word of a clause (about 1 in 6, never two in a row) and for the giant step numerals; Playfair Display Regular caps squeezed x0.88 for the promise title and panel labels; Inter Tight 700 in red for the hook montage words; Montserrat 800 with the gradient fill for the one keyword of the outro
type.substitutions: Instrument Serif Italic (reference numerals and serif words; no Cyrillic) -> Playfair Display Italic; Instrument Serif Regular caps -> Playfair Display Regular squeezed x0.88; Helvetica Now Display Bold (red hook words) -> Inter Tight 700; Plus Jakarta Sans 800 (gradient keyword) -> Montserrat 800. All from templates/fonts (Cyrillic + Latin woff2), copied into assets/fonts per reel.
type.never: em dashes on screen; words that claim what the speaker did not say; caption words under 56 px; SVG filter:url(#id) (HyperFrames 0.8.159 renders every other clip black: RGB split = three channel copies)

palette.title: #F8FAF9
palette.caption: #FDFEFC
palette.note: red only on the hook montage words; electric blue for a box under a word and the Step 3 field; the gradient on ONE word per reel at most (the payoff); the reference's scene tints for B-roll captions: #FAFCD4 cream, #DEEAC2 pale green, #E2CC9A amber, #6ACBE4 blue, #ED6A7A red-pink (pick the one of the clip's light)

insert_frame: B&W paper print: the object photocopied (steep curve, crushed blacks), a 70-90 % wide card with a slight tilt / keystone and sometimes a black bar, on #FAFAFA paper, swapped on a ~10 fps clock with 1-3 px jitter (make_prints)
paper panel on navy (E18): a #F4F1EA panel x 200-880 y 560-1480 playing the clip in a 648x888 window, a tiny line above and a Playfair label; fade-up from dark in one frame
full screen (E22): the clip fills 9:16 (1080p or better), captions tinted to its light with a glow of the same hue, pushed back on entry
drawn on the white page: SVG line drawings (#111722 strokes, missing parts dashed at 30 %), never clip art or stock icons
the cream icon card (E4): a black disk r 113 at (541, 960) with one drawn icon inside, tiny words hugging it

motion.rule: hard cuts on word onsets; all motion lives in the elements: push-backs (circ.out), the numeral shrink, element whips, blur ramps before a cut; nothing moves or filters the face except the one punch-in
motion.settle: push-back circ.out: opening layer x1.36 -> 1 in 0.6 s with a linear x1.057 drift over the world; montage pushes 1.36 / 1.22; step words x1.25 in 1.04 s, drift x1.0975; step numeral x1.48 -> 1 in 0.88 s + blur 14/6/3/0 px, drift x1.156; title block 1/0.855 in 0.76 s and x1.12 in 0.48 s on the big word; B-roll captions x1.47 in 1.24 s
motion.entrances: the first word of a face world fades over 6 frames (0, .11, .51, .80, .91, .96, 1) and rises 30 px (power2.out); flicker-on (E8) on the stressed word: 6 stepped opacity keys; step-card glow 10 frames then a hard step down
motion.exits: X1 blur-out 1/2/4/7/11/16 px over the last 6 frames; X3 brighten to white + blur over 7 frames; X4 push-out left power2.in 0.75 s with growing blur, the next caption layer enters from x +400 (circ.out 1.24 s); X5 a 1-frame scale jump under an 8 % white lift; X7 fade-up from dark 35 % -> 100 % in one frame; X8 one punch-in x1.20 per reel (scale only)
motion.stepped: prints on a 2-4 frame clock (~10 fps), the cream card icon on twos, counters one value per frame

sound.rule: a sound only where a world changes or something enters; none on caption words or on cuts inside a run; the payoff quiet (one soft whoosh at most)
sound.bed: one steady bed from 0 s to the end, no ducking, fade out the last 1.5 s; data-volume 0.18 (~9 dB under the voice; the reference: 6-9 dB); a hip-hop / lo-fi groove 85-95 BPM (the founding reel: library lo-fi-02, the closest to the reference's 88.6 BPM boom-bap)
sound.density: 3.5-4.5 SFX per 10 s (reference 3.6 on world changes; the founding reel 27 in 63 s = 4.3)
sound.timing: whooshes start 3-10 frames before the cut and run through it; a riser ends on the cut frame (back-timed, trimmed with media-start); hits / impacts / booms on the cut frame or +2 frames; UI pops and clicks 1-4 frames after their picture; a blur-out carries a whoosh that starts with the blur
sound.roles: whoosh-1/2/3 into a card or back to the face, whoosh-cine into a picture world or a big card, cinematic-deep-boom on frame 0 and the biggest reveal, cinematic-cine-hit on a step card, cinematic-rumble-riser / riser-1 back-timed into a step, impact-1 on a cream card or the title's big word, pop-1/2 and click-1 on diagram items and counters
sound.never: the voice lifted or ducked; SFX on caption swaps; a meme sound; the same whoosh three times in a row
sound.missing: a reverse whoosh (push-out), a short 0.6 s gap riser (the rumble riser is trimmed instead), paper / print flips for the montage, a real boom-bap bed with a clap on 2 and 4

budgets.face: the speaker's face on screen 35-45 % of the reel (reference 40.5 %, the founding reel 38.4 %); every look-away in build/cover_windows.json under a card (coverage.txt lists any that show)
budgets.pace: a new world every 1-2 s on average (the founding reel: 29 worlds in 63 s); no world longer than ~4.6 s; the hook stack in the first 5-12 s
budgets.pictures: few, each the noun of its line: 4-8 generated B&W object stills for one montage, one clip for the metaphor, drawn diagrams; stock video only via broll_fetch.py (1080p+, Mixkit 2160p / Pexels)
budgets.people: the B-roll people rules (people-rules.json; empty by default) and no nudity; one person doing the line's action at most; every picture through insert_prep.py --line and a broll_vision.py picks sheet

film: the speaker's face as shot: no grade, no filter
vary_per_reel: the components (new every reel: components.py plan --style step-deck): the three hook devices, the promise card, the metaphor insert and its frame, each step's illustration, the transitions used, the outro device
the pictures (the nouns of the speaker's lines) and the drawn diagrams
which step colour comes first when a reel has more than three steps (the rotation continues navy, off-white, blue)
grade_rule: none: the speaker's footage stays as shot; inserts are conformed to it
components_rule: the house look is the type, captions, accents, insert framing and the speaker's face as shot; phone-UI scenes, paper props, polaroid / card / collage treatments, transitions, hook and outro devices are NEW every reel (scripts/components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json)
